preconditions.description: The garden dimensions n and m must be within the specified bounds.
The number of important squares k must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in important_squares)
preconditions.description: All important squares must have valid coordinates within the garden.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of dead plants and the garden plan with 'X' for concrete-covered squares and '.' for uncovered squares.

postconditions.expression: all(plan[x-1][y-1] == 'X' for x, y in important_squares)
postconditions.description: All important squares must be covered with concrete.
There must be a path of concrete-covered squares between any two important squares.
